g.text: The 32 people appearing in at least 8 distinct territories; the 18 holding the most seats are shown, by identifier as the dataset records it. The bar is the firm count, the
number after the dot the territory count. 76% of directors appear in one territory only: the handful spanning eight or more are the human frame of figure 24. Three of
these identifiers — “paris”, “laurent”, “a-paris-c” — are extraction residue rather than people: a bare surname resolution could not attach, and a place read as a
name. They stay visible rather than being filtered out silently, because a pseudo-actor holding a real structural position is the thing a reader needs to know.
